verdict.rationale: Railway documents an MCP server and CLI that let AI agents create projects, deploy templates, manage environments, and redeploy services (railway-docs-20, railway-docs-15), which functions as a programmatic interface for AI-native drivers. However, probing for a standard public API spec (OpenAPI/Swagger) returned 404 on all candidate paths, indicating no conventional documented REST/GraphQL API surface (railway-probe-2). Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/GraphQL API reference, independent confirmation of API completeness beyond MCP tool coverage.
